title: Quintessential $α$-attractors fit DESI
summary: We study quintessence in $α$-attractor models in light of recent DESI indications for dynamical dark energy. We show that the \emph{knee} of the attractor potential provides an excellent approximation to the axion-like quintessence model used as a DESI benchmark. This leads to a simple relation between the axion decay constant $f_a$ and the attractor parameter $α$, allowing the experimental constraints to be translated into a preference for $α=\mathcal{O}(1)$, in agreement with string-motivated expectations.
